label: v3-student-1-c1-refs
pipeline: V3/compose case 3 (a specific thing; the reference supplied by hand, the state manager assumed perfect)
brief:
SETTING:
Present-day autumn, over one school week in a quiet suburban town. The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. Evan sits beside the windows; Maya and Leo sit at the neighboring desks, close enough to see his paper. Morning light falls across the desktops, while the corridor beyond the classroom door stays dim. The upstairs bedroom has pale blue walls, one window facing a quiet street, and a wooden desk beneath it. It sits above the family kitchen, away from the school; at night, the window reflects the desk lamp rather than the street. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Keep these clothes and details unchanged. The film uses naturalistic light, restrained contrast, and a softly muted grade: cool classroom mornings, warm lamplight at night, with no exaggerated change in color when Evan succeeds.

CLIP 1 OF 3 (15 seconds; what happens in clip 2 is not shown here):
The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. Begin in a medium shot of Evan beside the windows. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. He turns over his returned test. Cut close: “38/100” is clear; other marks are indistinct. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Maya leans over and points at the score. Leo looks, smirks, and nudges Maya; she covers a mocking grin. Evan lowers his eyes and pulls the paper toward himself. End close on his hand covering the score.

tools.prompt: Create a 15-second silent naturalistic school-drama scene about a returned test, widescreen 16:9. Cool autumn morning light, restrained contrast, realistic classroom textures and an intimate, uncomfortable mood. Five coherent shots in the same second-floor classroom, preserving faces, clothing, desk positions and the test throughout. 0–3 seconds: medium shot of @evan, a young man with short black hair, round black-rimmed glasses and a navy hoodie, turning over his returned test at the window-side desk; cream walls and east windows overlooking a paved courtyard establish the room, with a slow camera push toward him. 3–6 seconds: tight oblique close-up of the test, its score reading exactly '38/100', all other marks indistinct; @maya, dark ponytail, mustard cardigan over a charcoal shirt and silver stud earrings, is leaned over from the neighboring desk and points at the score; morning light crosses the paper as the camera slides slightly sideways. 6–9 seconds: medium two-shot of @leo, short curly brown hair, gray sweatshirt and thin red wristband, nudging @maya with his elbow; his eyes remain on the test with a smug smirk, while her hand conceals a mocking grin; neighboring desks remain in rows behind them, with a subtle lateral camera move. 9–12 seconds: medium close-up of @evan, eyes lowered and shoulders drawn inward, pulling the test toward himself with his palm covering the score; the window edge remains beside him, with a gentle push inward. 12–15 seconds: separate tight close-up of @evan's motionless hand covering the score on the test, only indistinct marks visible around his fingers on the sunlit desktop; hold this final composition without camera movement. Softly muted color, restrained pacing, no heightened color shift. No dialogue, subtitles or text overlays; clip 1 of 3 ends on the concealed score.
